svg.title: Peak AI NPC — how a conversation works
svg.desc: An animated overview of Peak AI NPC for FiveM. A player speaks or types to a nearby NPC. The FiveM server validates the interaction and sends approved context to a self-hosted AI gateway. The gateway uses a selected AI model, the NPC's personality and persistent memory. Optional gameplay tool requests return to the FiveM server, which validates and executes allowed tools and sends the result back to the model. The NPC replies with subtitles and optional spatial voice. Player facts and relationship state can be used in future conversations. Provider credentials remain in the gateway. The example dialogue is illustrative. The animation repeats every 18 seconds and respects reduced-motion preferences.
svg.metadata: Created for Peak-Studios/peak-ai-npc. Architecture sources: README.md, docs/INTEGRATION.md, docs/NPC_AUTHORING_GUIDE.md and docs/PRIVACY_AND_OPERATIONS.md, read 2026-09-18. This is an explanatory illustration, not a recording or a measured performance demonstration. No scripts, external images, external fonts, or external stylesheets.

g.text: Real conversations. Lasting memories. Server-controlled actions.
Use a hosted or local AI model.
* Speech input and output require configured providers.
